name: Adultery And Divorce
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a grievous sin that destroys the soul and dishonors God's covenant, as seen in the commandments and warnings in Exodus 20:14, Leviticus 20:10, and Proverbs 6:32. The Lord’s displeasure with divorce is also emphasized, revealing that He hates the act of putting away a spouse, which can conceal deeper violence and betrayal (Malachi 2:16). Jesus reaffirms these truths in the New Testament, reminding believers of the sacredness of marriage and the seriousness of both adultery and divorce (Matthew 5:27, 31). Together, these verses call Christians to uphold faithfulness and integrity in marriage as a reflection of God’s holy design.
